series_mark: LIVING UNDER THE RULE OF THE KING

slides.headline: He sold everything he owned. And he was happy about it.
body: Rev Ifeayinchukwu Obi told this story on Sunday.
A merchant spends his life looking for good pearls.
One day he finds one worth more than everything he owns.
So he sells the lot. House. Business. All of it.

slides.headline: Now look at his face.
body: He has just lost everything he spent his life building.
And the word the Bible uses for how he feels is joy.
slides.kicker: That is the part Rev Obi wanted us to notice.

scripture.text: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

slides.eyebrow: WHY IT IS NOT A LOSS
body: Nobody calls it a sacrifice when you swap something small for something huge.
You call that a good deal.
He was not giving things up. He was trading up.

slides.headline: So what is the pearl?
body: The kingdom of God. Life the way God meant you to have it.
slides.kicker: Not a religion. Not a rule book.

body: Rev Obi's point on Sunday: the kingdom was never the thing that costs you the good life.
It is the road to it.
Everything else gets added on the way.

scripture.text: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.

slides.headline: Living Under The Rule Of The KING
